/*转仓买入*/ select case when tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F01','F18') then tpd2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID when tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F17' and fp.PROFIT_TYPE = '02' then tpd2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID else tpd.R_TRADE_ID end tradeId, tpd2.ps from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd /*卖出交易表*/ INNER JOIN trd_fin_product_deal_total tfpdt ON tpd.totle_trade_id = tfpdt.totle_trade_id left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = tpd.COUNTER_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd2 on tpd2.TRADE_ID = tpd.R_TRADE_ID /*买入交易表*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID where pp.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = '01'/*内部转仓*/ and tpd2.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and tpd2.TRADE_STATUS = '01' /*有效状态*/ and (tpd.trade_id = #{tradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
union all /*转仓卖出*/ select case when tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F01','F18') then tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID when tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F17' and fp.PROFIT_TYPE = '02' then tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID else tpd.TRADE_ID end tradeId, tpd.ps from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd /*买入交易表*/ INNER JOIN trd_fin_product_deal_total tfpdt ON tpd.totle_trade_id = tfpdt.totle_trade_id left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = tpd.COUNTER_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd2 on tpd2.TRADE_ID = tpd.R_TRADE_ID /*卖出交易表*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID where pp.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = '01'/*内部转仓*/ and tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01' /*有效状态*/ and (tpd.R_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tpd2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

/*转仓买入*/ select tpd.R_TRADE_ID tradeId, tpd2.ps from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd /*卖出交易表*/ left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = tpd.COUNTER_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd2 on tpd2.TRADE_ID = tpd.R_TRADE_ID /*买入交易表*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID where pp.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = '01'/*内部转仓*/ AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pa_trd_product_deal pa WHERE pa.trade_id = TPD.Trade_Id) and tpd2.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and tpd2.TRADE_STATUS = '01' /*有效状态*/ and (tpd.trade_id = #{tradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) union all /*转仓卖出*/ select tpd.TRADE_ID tradeId, tpd.ps from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd /*买入交易表*/ left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = tpd.COUNTER_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd2 on tpd2.TRADE_ID = tpd.R_TRADE_ID /*卖出交易表*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID where pp.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = '01'/*内部转仓*/ AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pa_trd_product_deal pa WHERE pa.trade_id = TPD.Trade_Id) and tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and tpd.TRADE_STATUS = '01' /*有效状态*/ and (tpd.R_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} or tpd2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
WHERE B_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.CASH_NUM AS cashNum,/**现金流序号**/ a.VDATE_UNADJUST AS vdateUnadjust,/**未调整的计算开始日**/ a.MDATE_UNADJUST AS mdateUnadjust,/**未调整的计算结束日**/ a.PAY_DATE_UNADJUST AS payDateUnadjust,/**未调整的计划支付日**/ a.VDATE AS vdate,/**调整后的计算开始日**/ a.MDATE AS mdate,/**调整后的计算结束日**/ a.PAY_DATE AS payDate,/**调整后的计划支付日**/ a.TERMDAYS AS termdays,/**计算周期天数**/ a.VDATE_Y AS vdateY,/**理论计息年度开始日**/ a.VDATE_TERM AS vdateTerm,/**完整周期开始日**/ a.MDATE_TERM AS mdateTerm,/**完整周期结束日**/ a.TERMDAYS_TERM termdaysTerm,/**完整周期计息天数**/ a.PRIN_AMT AS prinAmt,/**计划支付本金**/ a.IS_PAY_INT AS isPayInt,/**是否支付利息**/ a.INT_AMT AS intAmt,/**计划支付利息**/ a.CASH_AMT AS cashAmt,/**计划支付现金流**/ a.CASH_UNIT_TYPE AS cashUnitType,/**现金流单位**/ a.CALC_FUNCTION AS calcFunction,/**计息算法**/ a.FREQUENCY AS frequency,/**年付息次数**/ a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId,/**金融产品代码**/ a.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType,/**金融产品类型**/ a.PAY_TYPE AS payType, /**支付方式**/ a.INT_PRIN_AMT intPrinAmt /**计息本金**/ FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.PAY_STATUS = #{payStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**是否已支付**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY a.FINPROD_ID,b.CASH_TYPE_1,b.CASH_TYPE_2,a.VDATE ASC
